questions.q: In OpenSearch 3.10, what is the default value of the new PPL setting that limits how many steps a single regex parse or rex match can take?
questions.expect: The dynamic setting plugins.ppl.regex.match.limit defaults to 100000 steps per parse or rex regex match.
questions.grading: Correct: names the PPL regex match limit setting with default 100000 (from 3.10). Partial: describes the setting but omits the default. Wrong: any other value, or an answer from another release's notes.

questions.q: Which additional scalar quantization levels did OpenSearch 3.9 add for Faiss and Lucene next to 1-bit, and what compression does each give?
questions.expect: 3.9 added 2-bit scalar quantization (x16 compression) and 4-bit (x8), alongside the existing 1-bit (x32), on the Faiss and Lucene engines.
questions.grading: Correct: 2-bit x16 and 4-bit x8. Partial: mentions 2-bit and 4-bit without ratios. Wrong: attributes the half_float 2/4-bit support (3.10) as the answer, or gives 1-bit only.

questions.q: What streaming methods did OpenSearch 3.8 add for sending ML predictions and agent output token by token over gRPC?
questions.expect: PredictModelStream and ExecuteAgentStream, which stream output token by token from remote models using protocol buffers over HTTP/2.
questions.grading: Correct: names PredictModelStream and ExecuteAgentStream (3.8). Partial: says gRPC streaming was added without method names. Wrong: cites a different release or unrelated feature.

questions.q: How did OpenSearch 3.7 let operators preview what an index lifecycle policy would do without changing anything?
questions.expect: 3.7 added the ISM Simulate API, which evaluates every transition condition against live index metrics and reports the next state without modifying cluster state.
questions.grading: Correct: ISM Simulate API in 3.7 that reports next state without modifying cluster state. Partial: names the API only. Wrong: an answer based on another release.

questions.q: What new data source connector did Nimbus Analytics get in the June 2026 release notes, and which plans can use it?
questions.expect: Nimbus Analytics 2.3 added the BigQuery data source connector, available on Starter, Pro and Enterprise.
questions.grading: Correct: BigQuery connector, Starter/Pro/Enterprise. Partial: connector without plans. Wrong: a feature from another month's notes.

questions.q: What changed for Nimbus Analytics Pro dashboards in the September 2026 release?
questions.expect: Analytics 2.4 raised the Pro dashboard widget limit from 25 to 40, applied automatically to existing Pro workspaces.
questions.grading: Correct: widget limit 25 to 40 for Pro. Partial: says the limit increased without numbers. Wrong: October's Enterprise changes (1-minute refresh, PDF export) or other months.

questions.q: What did Nimbus announce in November 2026 about SMS codes for two-factor authentication, and what should users do?
questions.expect: SMS two-factor codes will be removed on March 31, 2027. Users should switch to an authenticator app or a passkey before then and remove SMS as a method.
questions.grading: Correct: removal date March 31, 2027 and switching to an authenticator app or passkey. Partial: date only. Wrong: citing the August passkey 2FA addition as the removal announcement.

questions.q: Under the Nimbus pricing currently in effect, what are the daily API request quota and the per-second burst limit for a Pro workspace's Gateway?
questions.expect: Pro workspaces get 100,000 requests per day and a burst limit of 100 requests per second.
questions.grading: Correct: 100,000 daily and 100 rps for Pro. Partial: only one of the two values. Wrong: 50 rps burst (2025 archive) or values for another plan.

questions.q: Per the pricing sheet that took effect March 1, 2026, how much storage did each Pro user get and was single sign-on available on Pro?
questions.expect: Each Pro user received 1 TB of storage, and SSO was included in Enterprise only, so Pro did not have it.
questions.grading: Correct: 1 TB per Pro user and SSO Enterprise-only. Partial: only storage. Wrong: saying SSO was on Pro (that is the September 15, 2026 sheet) or 500 GB (2025 sheet).

questions.q: What did Globex report about the Gateway failing for several minutes with the status page showing nothing, and how many users were affected?
questions.expect: Globex reported that Gateway calls failed with E5003 for several minutes while the status page showed nothing; about 23 users were affected, first seen August 2, 2026.
questions.grading: Correct: E5003 outage report, about 23 users, first seen Aug 2, 2026. Partial: report without user count. Wrong: another tenant's similar 503 ticket (e.g. Acme, Initech, Umbrella) or Globex's 429 tickets.

questions.q: What did Acme ask about single sign-on in its support tickets, and how many users were affected?
questions.expect: Acme (Starter plan) said it wants to enforce SSO for all members, currently signs in with passwords, and asked which plan it needs; about 2 users affected, first seen October 6, 2026.
questions.grading: Correct: Acme's SSO plan question with about 2 users. Partial: topic without count. Wrong: user counts from Globex, Initech or Umbrella SSO tickets.

questions.q: What did Umbrella report about a replaced laptop that could not sync, and how many users were affected?
questions.expect: Umbrella reported that a new laptop showed E4019 because the old device still counted against the device limit; about 33 users affected, first seen October 15, 2026.
questions.grading: Correct: E4019 device limit issue with about 33 users. Partial: issue without count. Wrong: Acme's or Globex's similar tickets with different counts.

questions.q: How long did the Nimbus Gateway outage in the US region on November 12, 2026 last, and what caused it?
questions.expect: Gateway in the US region returned E5003 for 47 minutes. A configuration push removed capacity from the request routers, so the remaining routers rejected requests they could not handle.
questions.grading: Correct: 47 minutes and the config push removing router capacity. Partial: duration only. Wrong: other incidents (September 21 webhook delays, October 2 Analytics refresh failures).

questions.q: According to the Gateway help center, how long do API keys last before they expire, and which error shows up when an expired key is used?
questions.expect: API keys expire after 1 year, and calls with an expired key return error E4011. The fix is to create a new key under Settings > Developer > API keys.
questions.grading: Correct: 1 year and E4011. Partial: only one. Wrong: other error codes such as E4290 or E5003.

questions.q: What did the Nimbus release notes for May 2026 announce for Nimbus Platform?
questions.expect: No document covers May 2026 Nimbus release notes; the available monthly notes start in June 2026, so the cluster cannot answer this.
questions.grading: Correct: states the information is not available. Wrong: presenting June or July 2026 features as May's.
